# Determine the Encoding of an HTML Byte Stream

This package implements the HTML Standard's [encoding sniffing algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/syntax.html#encoding-sniffing-algorithm), allowing you to determine the correct character encoding of an HTML byte stream.

One of its key features is the pre-scan of the first **1024 bytes** of the document to detect `<meta charset>` declarations, following the HTML Standard specification.

## Installation

```bash
npm install html-encoding-sniffer
```

## Basic Usage

```js
const htmlEncodingSniffer = require("html-encoding-sniffer");
const fs = require("fs");

const htmlBuffer = fs.readFileSync("./html-page.html");
const sniffedEncoding = htmlEncodingSniffer(htmlBuffer);

console.log(sniffedEncoding);
```

The function returns the canonical [encoding name](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#names-and-labels), not an encoding label.

You can then decode the HTML using the `whatwg-encoding` package:

```js
const whatwgEncoding = require("whatwg-encoding");

const htmlString = whatwgEncoding.decode(htmlBuffer, sniffedEncoding);
```

## Options

You can customize the encoding sniffing process by passing an options object:

```js
const sniffedEncoding = htmlEncodingSniffer(htmlBuffer, {
  transportLayerEncodingLabel,
  defaultEncoding
});
```

### `transportLayerEncodingLabel`

An encoding label obtained from the transport layer (for example, the HTTP `Content-Type` header). This takes precedence over all other sources except a Byte Order Mark (BOM).

### `defaultEncoding`

The fallback encoding used when no valid transport-layer encoding or detectable encoding is found.

Default value:

```text
windows-1252
```

This follows the HTML Standard's recommended default for "All other locales."

## How the Detection Works

The algorithm checks the following sources in order:

1. Byte Order Mark (BOM)
2. Transport-layer encoding (HTTP `Content-Type`)
3. `<meta charset>` declaration
4. `<meta http-equiv="Content-Type">`
5. Default encoding (`windows-1252` unless overridden)

## Specification

This package follows the HTML Standard's official Encoding Sniffing Algorithm:

https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/syntax.html#encoding-sniffing-algorithm
